summary:
漢威聯合EPS超預期、營收年增2.44%，航太與自動化組合穩健。
• EPS 2.45美元，超越預期2.32美元，正向驚喜5.55%
• 營收91.4億美元，年增2.44%溫和成長
• 航太事業受惠商用與國防需求維持強勁
• 多角化工業組合與分拆計畫聚焦核心成長
ai_view:
訊號偏正向：EPS超標但營收僅年增2.44%，顯示獲利改善主要來自利潤率與成本管理而非強勁需求，航太是主要亮點。短期股價受惠分拆價值釋放題材，但36.67倍本益比在溫和成長下評價偏滿。中期關鍵在投資組合重組執行。追蹤指標：航太有機營收與利潤率、短週期事業訂單、各分拆事業進度、調整後營業利潤率，以及全年EPS指引與資本配置。

需留意：整體營收成長溫和，部分短週期事業需求疲弱；本益比36.67偏高，成長溫和下評價承壓；分拆重組執行與整合風險

summary_en:
Honeywell beat EPS with 2.44% revenue growth, as aerospace and automation portfolios stayed steady.
• EPS of $2.45 beat the $2.32 estimate, a 5.55% positive surprise
• Revenue of $9.14B grew a modest 2.44%
• Aerospace benefits from strong commercial and defense demand
• Diversified industrial portfolio and spin-off plans focus on core growth

ai_view_en:
Signal is mildly positive: an EPS beat with only 2.44% revenue growth shows earnings improvement driven mainly by margins and cost management rather than strong demand, with aerospace the key bright spot. Near-term the stock benefits from spin-off value-unlock themes, but a 36.67x P/E looks full amid modest growth. Mid-term, portfolio-restructuring execution is key. Track: aerospace organic revenue and margins, short-cycle business orders, spin-off progress, adjusted operating margin, and full-year EPS guidance plus capital allocation.

Watch：Overall revenue growth is modest, with some short-cycle businesses soft; A 36.67x P/E is elevated, pressuring valuation amid modest growth; Spin-off restructuring execution and integration risk
